topic: How does channel gain variability from weather affect optimal power allocation strategies across subbands?
response: Channel gain variability from weather affects optimal power allocation strategies across subbands by introducing uncertainty and potentially significant differences in channel gains between users, even within the same beam. This can lead to inefficient resource allocation and reduced system performance.
reference_context: The context states that one third of users undergo rainy weather conditions, degrading the channel gain by at most a factor of 10 dB, with maximum differences of up to 13 dB between user channel gains.
